title: Pocket Hose Ballistic Double UV Edition 50 FT Expandable Garden Hose w/Pocket Pivot Swivel Connector, Anti-Burst Sleeve Reinforced w/Bulletproof Fiber, Lightweight, No-Kink, Compact, AS SEEN ON TV
features: DOUBLE UV PROTECTION FOR LONGER-LASTING PERFORMANCE: Our Premium Pocket Hose Ballistic features 2X the UV protection to help shield the hose from sun exposure and keep it performing and looking like new, season after season

BALLISTIC-GRADE ANTI-BURST SLEEVE: Reinforced with a Liquid Crystal Polymer strand used in bulletproof applications that is 5X stronger than steel* for added durability during everyday dragging and tugging. *Strength-to-weight comparison vs. steel; refers to reinforcement strand only, not the entire hose; not equal thickness. Results may vary.

WORLD’S #1 EXPANDING HOSE — BACKED BY 100+ PATENTS: Pocket Hose Ballistic expands up to 3X into a full-power 3/4-inch hose, then shrinks back for compact, practically bone-dry storage. Lightweight, easy to handle, and built for everyday watering
POCKET PIVOT SWIVEL CONNECTOR: Swivels 360° at the spigot to help reduce twists, snags, and kinks while you move, helping maintain smoother water flow

3-LAYER LATEX CORE + LEAK-RESISTANT UPGRADES: Features 3 layers of high-strength latex, re-engineered thicker washers to help resist leaks, stronger APT connector protectors, and solid lead-free connectors infused with real copper
